packets.title: Seal the semantic ledger and proof boundary
exit_criteria: Every pinned source unit has an audited disposition: model obligation, external implementation/deployment obligation, context, or superseded requirement with a reconciliation reference.
Every in-scope normative clause maps to a fixed atomic obligation and a closure packet. Splits and merged duplicates preserve source traceability and the original requirement.

A machine-checked disposition ledger establishes semantic completeness. Replace hard-coded incomplete flags in catalog/check only after that check exists, while preserving the full-qualification guard.

packets.title: Audit and reuse the existing proof corpus
exit_criteria: Every frozen model obligation records its existing theorem witnesses or its exact missing proof, with no credit from theorem names alone.
Existing finite examples, arbitrary trace theorems, conditional liveness results and assumptions have distinct audited scopes.
Each remaining proof gap belongs to R03-R08. Redundant examples and helper additions are omitted unless they discharge a frozen obligation or expose a counterexample.

packets.title: Close admission, ownership and rate accounting
exit_criteria: All frozen Retry, aggregate pending/established limits, source attribution, handshake-credit and generation-owned callback obligations have witnesses at the required model scope.
Per-source and shared rate/cost envelopes compose across both swarms and cover denial, overflow, cancellation, stale completion and cleanup paths.
Negative controls reject weakened ownership, credit, source attribution and resource-bound invariants. Runtime charge and storage dominance assumptions stay explicit.

packets.title: Close policy, source churn and recovery models
exit_criteria: The fixed ledger's authoritative policy, receipt provenance, one-pre-state enforcement and live source/pending attribution obligations have model witnesses.
Expiry, bans/debt, capacity changes, policy generations, bootstrap/reconnect, record freshness, rotation/reload and Launch/Hub/Rotation/Later model obligations are closed.
Policy/source/resource composition retains each invariant under mixed traces, with negative controls and explicit clock, authority, persistence and runtime-query premises.

packets.title: Close queue, capacity and schedule composition
exit_criteria: Frozen obligations for bounded construction, immutable payload charges, rejection, deferred suffix retention, resizing and capacity handoff have general model witnesses.
Whole, segmented, concatenated and lowered schedules agree on state, receipts, cost and conditional service at the ledger's required scope.
Admission limits, temporary/rejected work, guard/maintenance/executor overhead and storage/cleanup premises have explicit proof boundaries and weakening controls.

packets.title: Close event-loop progress and conditional service
exit_criteria: Accept/Retry/Refuse/Ignore, polls, timers, errors and cancellation have exact modeled continuation and cleanup obligations discharged.
FIFO prefix service and vote/certificate/epoch priority follow from explicit cumulative fuel, scheduling and delivery premises under the allowed varying-fuel traces.

Task creation, permits, deadlines, wakeups and hold-time obligations are either modeled with witnesses or retained as sourced external obligations. No unconditional wall-clock liveness claim is inferred.

packets.title: Close authentication and optimization boundaries
exit_criteria: Frozen model obligations for certificate/token/payload checks, unverified identities, closed admission and early refusal have witnesses.
Repeated verification removal, gossip ordering and aggregate verification preserve the stated model behavior, including proof-of-possession prerequisites.
Cryptographic, parser and transport assumptions are named premises with counterexamples for invalid privilege or bypass conditions; actual implementation security remains external.

packets.title: Close the remaining workstream abstractions
exit_criteria: Every frozen W0-W9 model obligation outside R03-R07 is discharged, including submission/admission semantics, retries, URL migration, bounded metrics/logging and topology/qualification rules.
Storage latency, hardware, provider networking, carried-patch upkeep, numerical policy and operator decisions have explicit sourced external obligations rather than invented model evidence.
The closure matrix has no unmapped normative unit, unassigned proof gap or unresolved model-side disposition; original and modified source conflicts are reconciled.

packets.title: Audit assumptions, mutations and completeness
exit_criteria: An adversarial audit maps every closed model obligation to its exact theorem statement, source clause, assumptions and relevant weakening controls.
The full pinned checker accepts the final proof bundle, reports an empty axiom set and rejects all required semantic mutations. Complete source and model coverage are derived from checked data.
Independent implementation/deployment qualification remains blocked when its evidence is missing, including regression of the existing incomplete-qualification guard.

packets.title: Seal and reproduce the proof package
exit_criteria: A clean reproducible run validates the frozen source ledger, model witnesses, provenance, axiom disclosure and semantic mutation suite, with reports pinned to the relevant proof inputs.
A separate proof-repository completion command requires R01-R09 and the checked semantic/model coverage certificates. The full qualification command retains all Rust, D01-D12 and M1-M6 requirements.
Generated coverage, trust documentation, reusable artifacts and the sourced external-obligation backlog agree with the final proof-package scope; all ten closure packets have audited evidence.
